caption: Our church's new giving app comes with a complimentary mark.
alt: Single-panel comic in a church foyer. A volunteer in a vest holds a sticker sheet labeled 'Forehead-Ready' while a dad in a polo holds up his phone to tap-to-pay at a small card reader on a folding table. A sign on the table reads 'Contactless Giving Pilot Program.' Speech bubbles: the volunteer says 'Tap-to-give is basically Revelation. Want a sticker?' and the dad replies 'Does it come off before lunch?'
